Global Platform for the South

Connecting Knowledge Innovation Policy Enterprise

A transdisciplinary platform connecting universities, governments, enterprise, and communities across the Global South — turning research into policy, and policy into impact.

Explore Our Work →Partner with GPS

GPS hubsPlanned hubsThe Global South

Who do we connect?

Universities, governments, businesses, civil society, innovators, researchers, artists, and communities.

What do we connect?

Knowledge, technology and innovation, policy, and enterprise — in every direction, never a straight line.

Why do we connect them?

To co-create solutions, opportunities, sustainable development, and societal impact across the Global South.

The GPS ecosystem

What makes GPS unlike anything else.

Four pillars in constant exchange, six kinds of actors in orbit, one destination. Hover any node — nothing here is linear.
